text: The Awanui River Flood Management Scheme is a comprehensive flood protection initiative in Northland, New Zealand, focusing on the Awanui River and Kaitāia urban area. Managed by the Northland Regional Council, the scheme has evolved from early tidal containment efforts to a modern program integrating structural upgrades, emergency bypasses, and ongoing maintenance. It aims to enhance floodwater conveyance, raise protection standards, and mitigate spill risks, supported by a region-wide funding model.
